Original synthetic WebGL geometry

This fixture draws numeric clip-space indexed triangles using the production decoder and renderer. It contains no game media or image payload. It is a synthetic renderer check, separate from live-world qualification.

Expected: green 60 × 60 square at top left; magenta 60 × 60 square at bottom left; yellow 60 × 60 square at top right; cyan triangle at bottom right. Orange covers the centre of a larger blue rectangle even though blue is submitted later. Both windings render.
